To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the OP of cognitive multi-relays with imperfect CSI is significantly affected by the asymmetry between primary and secondary fading channels and CSI error.
the OP of the secondary network decreases with increasing the number of relays and increases with the number of primary interferers.
the OP of the cognitive multi-relay network with imperfect CSI of interfering links can be approximated by the proposed expression in low SNR regimes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the OP performance of a cognitive network with asymmetric fading channels and imperfect CSI.
the effect of asymmetric channel fading on the performance of a cognitive network.
the effect of asymmetric channels on the performance of a cognitive relay system in the presence of imperfect CSI.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the effect of asymmetric Rician and Rayleigh fading on the OP of the secondary network can be neglected in high SNR regimes.

the OP of the secondary network can be significantly improved by increasing CSI quality, decreasing CSI imperfection, and increasing the fading parameters of secondary channels, and decreasing the fading parameters of interfering links.
the effect of imperfect CSI on the OP is more significant in asymmetric fading channels than in symmetric ones.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have investigated the effect of CSI imperfection and asymmetric fading on the OP performance of cognitive multi relay systems.
the OP of the cognitive multi-relay transmission system with imperfect CSI is derived for asymmetric fading channels.
the OP performance of cognitive multi- relay systems with imperfect CSI of interfering channels is investigated under the assumption of asymmetric Rician and Rayleigh fading channels.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the effect of CSI imperfection on OP values can be reduced by increasing the number of relays in the secondary network.
the OP performance of cognitive multi- relay systems can be significantly improved by using imperfect CSI of interfering links.
imperfect CSI can be used as a design parameter to optimize the performance of cognitive systems in asymmetric fading channels.
